title: The Thera/Santorini theory of Atlantis

tellings.quote: island of Terara and the Santorini eruption was the story behind Atlantis. Well, this happened 900 years before Plato.

plain: A researcher, Randall Carlson, describes the idea that the huge volcanic eruption on the Greek island of Thera, now called Santorini, was the real event behind Atlantis, the lost land described by the Greek philosopher Plato. He points out that the eruption happened about 900 years before Plato. He raises it to weigh what the Atlantis story might really remember.
